versions.changelog:
Initial release of rent-odessa skill:

- Enables search for 2-room apartments for long-term rent in Odessa within 15,000 UAH/month.
- Supports queries via specific triggers and phrases.
- Applies detailed filters (rooms, area, pets allowed, new building, furnished, etc.).
- Collects listings from major sources: OLX, DOM.RIA, flatfy, rieltor, lun, Atlanta, REM.
- Outputs results in a formatted, user-friendly message with links and details.
- Provides fallback info if no apartments are found on any or all sources.
